notTokenised.liveTheme: dark only. html has class dark on every public page. prefers-color-scheme light and dark both paint the dark set.
notTokenised.lightSet: Declared on :root in the stylesheet. Not observed as a painted public page.
notTokenised.focusRing: Not captured as a visible change. Programmatic focus on measured controls did not change background, outline or box-shadow in components-computed.json.
notTokenised.pressed: Not captured. The kit could not hold :active long enough for a stable reading.
notTokenised.disabled: Not captured. No disabled control was shown on the public pages that were opened.
notTokenised.errorField: Not captured. No form was submitted, so no validation error was shown.
notTokenised.hover: Several controls showed no computed-style change on hover. The change may live on an inner layer or a transform. See components.md.
notTokenised.successWarningInfo: Declared only as sonner toaster hooks. No toast was shown.
